title: Beaconwell HealthBridge
text:
Beaconwell HealthBridge

use_case_summary:
Primary: clinical support chat for nurses (low-latency triage), embeddings for medical notes search, summarization of visit notes for billing. Targets: 200 qps peak for embeddings indexing pipeline, sub-300ms p50 latency for chat, strict PHI residency and audit logging.

qualifying_summary:
Good product-market fit on technical side; mid-market healthtech with regulated data. Budget potential in range but procurement slow; principal blockers are security approvals and internal exec sponsor. SE recommends private deployment (VPC/on-prem) if contract revenue justified.

next_step:
Reconnect with VP Eng + security; send tailored security appendix and ask for exec sponsor

notes:
2026-02-18 demo — attended: CTO (Raj Kapoor), Head of Security (Leah Morris), Product Lead (Amir Patel), Sr. Data Engineer (Kira N.)
Demo highlights: liked Redwood's routing/fallback story, cost controls (Optimize suggestions), and ability to pin model versions. CTO: 'Good fit if we can isolate PHI and guarantee residency.'
POC ask: 2-week dedicated pool trial, ingest anonymized clinical notes for embeddings + a QA chat flow. Proposed config: 2x A100 equivalent, prefix caching enabled, private VPC deployment behind their firewall.
Security: requested SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, KMS/HSM diagram, audit log retention policy, and proof of data residency (US-east). Raised concerns about third-party telemetry in hosted mode.
Follow-ups: AE sent custom pricing + POC SOW 2026-02-19 (drive link above). SE delivered security appendix 2026-02-23. Sent nudge email 2026-02-25 — no reply.
Post-demo outreach: voicemail left 2026-03-02 (asked for VP Eng intro). Followed up w/ Leah on 2026-03-04 via Gmail thread (linked) — asked for estimated procurement timeline; reply: 'budget under review with finance.'
Competitive signal: they ran a short eval with Anthropic endpoints earlier this year — team cited faster throughput for small chat loads but lacked on-prem option. Also evaluating local self-hosted stack for PHI use-cases.
Internal sentiment: product liked features; security is gating. No clear champion above Product Lead — CTO supportive but says need exec-level sponsor in Business Ops to unlock budget.
AE assessment: Warm technical interest but stalled commercially. Risk: if we don't get a security-verified paper or exec sponsor by end of March, account will be deprioritized (budget freeze reported by Amir).
Suggested immediate actions: 1) Send condensed security one-pager + SOC2/ISO evidence; 2) Ask for a short security Q&A call (SE + Leah); 3) Request intro to VP Business Ops to discuss budget timeline.
If no response after two more contact attempts, plan to mark as closed-stalled and set a 90-day nurture cadence.
